industry_exposure_summary.limits: Exposure arithmetic, not a forecast. Port volumes are all-cargo; shares are US-import, not global.
industry_exposure_summary.method: exposure_pct = port_yoy_pct x measured country share of US imports in each industry line

definitions.baseline: The 358 calendar days immediately preceding the current seven-day window. This is not a full one-year baseline. A complete denominator is required.
definitions.counts: Only the exact n_total (chokepoints) or portcalls (ports/fallback) count field. Cargo imports, exports and capacity cannot substitute.
definitions.interpretation: A change in vessel calls is not a change in tons, cargo value, national exports or corporate earnings. No disruption, inflation, industry-supply or portfolio conclusion follows from these arithmetic comparisons.
definitions.scope: All stored rows and entities are inspectable, including invalid, future and unavailable values. Source selection, query completeness, release vintages, AIS methodology, seasonal effects and economic causation remain unqualified.
definitions.windows: Every calendar date in a window must have one identified nonnegative whole-number count. Missing days are not zero; the latest dated null cannot be replaced by an older reading.
definitions.year_over_year: Seven consecutive calendar dates ending at the latest observation compared with seven ending on that date in the prior calendar year. February 29 without an anniversary stays unavailable. Not a weekday- or holiday-adjusted comparison.

measurement_review.source: complete retained native PortWatch history; not a complete world-port census
